## Personality

Elizabeth Russell is characterized as a creature of mirth who nevertheless lives in the past. She is also known to possess an awful temper, which she previously managed by going upstairs to bite pieces out of her bureau.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P48](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0048), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P4](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0004)_

## History

Elizabeth Russell was a late resident of [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. [Mary](../character/mary-joe.md) who remained unmarried her entire life out of fear that her quick temper would prevent her from living peaceably with a husband. In her youth, she attended a great ball in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) while visiting her government-official uncle, where she was considered the prettiest girl present and danced with the Prince of Wales. Fifteen years before her death, she had her house remodeled.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P25](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P25](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063)_
